description:
Move the configuration, schema, serve, steering and lifecycle workflow tests in `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow` onto the shared CLI process fixture, so they carry no binary locator, repository setup or id scraping of their own.

## Background

Shared test support provides one CLI process fixture. It owns a temporary repository, spawns the `jit` binary built for the calling integration target with inherited `JIT_*` variables removed, initialises git on request and reads created ids from `--json` output. Before it existed, each CLI test file carried its own binary locator (`fn jit_binary`, `assert_cmd`'s `cargo_bin!` or `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_jit")`), its own repository setup (`setup_test_repo`, `setup_repo`, `setup`, `setup_test_env` and similar), private git helpers (`run_git`, `git`, `init_git`, `setup_git_repo`), and in places scraped ids from human-readable output with `split_whitespace`. Inherited `JIT_AGENT_ID`, `JIT_DATA_DIR`, `JIT_WORKTREE_*`, `JIT_ALLOW_DELETION` and `JIT_LOCK_TIMEOUT` values leaked into those spawns.

These files include `integration_test.rs` (17 `split_whitespace` sites), `workflow_tests.rs`, `serve_cli_tests.rs`, and `steering_scenarios.rs` and `project_config_tests.rs`, which remove or pin chosen `JIT_*` variables by hand.

This entry covers `config_get_tests.rs`, `project_config_tests.rs`, `help_cross_reference_tests.rs`, `test_cli_consistency.rs`, `version_cli_tests.rs`, `format_compat_cli_tests.rs`.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/format_compat_cli_tests.rs`: `setup_too_new_repo` (`:19`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: No file in this migration's scope defines or calls a binary locator, a repository setup or a git initialisation helper other than the shared fixture's, including one defined in another test file; each test spawns `jit` through the shared CLI process fixture.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test that depends on a `JIT_*` variable sets it through the fixture for the process it spawns.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each migrated test asserts the property it asserted before and passes alone, in any order and in parallel.
title: configuration and CLI-surface tests spawn jit through the shared process fixture
